summary: Scale Improved and smoother Settings search

changes.title: Keep the original Scale and add Scale Improved
changes.detail: Retain the accepted animation pace and growth. Improved uses separate opacity timing, bounded continuous momentum, stable character matching and native text-run positioning. Only these two choices remain; previous removed styles fall back to Scale.

changes.title: Compare both styles in the playground
changes.detail: Regular and rapid replay with repeated letters and contractions, plus existing live keyboard tryout.

changes.title: Reduce Settings search and rendering contention
changes.detail: Index searchable settings once, run public built-in matching off the UI thread with current-query verification, retain search ranking and stable row keys. Use a lightweight Settings header instead of offscreen blur while typing; idle blur and explicit overlays are preserved.
